part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `applyInputSourceContents` (packages/babel-generator/src/printer.ts:166): when an `inputSourceMap` lacks a `sourcesContent` field, the code indexed `sourcesContent[i]` on `undefined` and crashed with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')". Changed it to `sourcesContent?.[i]`, which safely passes `undefined` to `setSourceContent` (yielding a `null`/`undefined` entry in the output map instead of throwing).

Validation:
- Rebuilt packages (`make build-no-bundle`) since tests run against compiled `lib/` output
- `yarn jest packages/babel-generator packages/babel-core`: 1043 passed, including the previously failing "inputSourceMap without sourcesContent" case
- Verified with a direct `transformSync` reproduction using an input map without `sourcesContent` — no crash, valid map produced
